subject: Evidence tool consolidation & TrustAdvisors pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence tool consolidation & TrustAdvisors pilot

Team —

Quick summary and ask: we currently have overlapping evidence collection and continuous monitoring across Vanta (prod) and a small Drata PoC. Legal and some product teams are asking for a simpler vendor footprint for audit prep and ongoing SOC2 maintenance. Rather than a full rip-and-replace, I propose a time-boxed 3-month pilot with TrustAdvisors (consulting + tooling orchestration) to: 

- Validate if we can consolidate evidence ingestion into a single pane (reduce duplicate agents & noise)
- Automate most of the manual evidence gaps we see during audits
- Produce a short SOW and a PO path we can roll into Q4 budget if results are positive

Why this matters now: procurement has flagged rising per-seat/agent costs and the SOC timeline for next year means we should reduce complexity. If the pilot shows 30–40% fewer manual touchpoints, we buy down headcount/time during audits.

Immediate asks:
1) Marcus — can you attach the last 12-month spend comparison (Vanta vs Drata + estimated professional services)?
2) Laura — please confirm what legal redlines are non-negotiable for an external consultant SOW (data access, subprocessing, liability).
3) Neha — procurement path: PO vs SaaS subscription; which provides the faster onboarding window?

I spoke briefly to Diana at TrustAdvisors — she said they can produce a draft SOW and pilot scope by Friday. Im attaching a quick vendor_pricing_comparison.csv and want to align on a PO cadence so we can get started as early as Sept 14 if approved.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_pricing_comparison.csv (spreadsheet with vendor list and topline numbers)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:03:05-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence tool consolidation & TrustAdvisors pilot

+1 on the pilot. Attached is the spend file you requested — breakout by product, license, and PS hours. Topline numbers:
- Current Vanta annual run rate (after discounts): ~$95,000
- Drata PoC (monthly): ~$7,500 (not yet annualized)
- Estimated TrustAdvisors pilot (3 months): $24,000 (includes 40 hours of onboarding PS + orchestration + two workshops)

My recommendation: run the 3-month TrustAdvisors pilot scoped to a single workload (Payments infra) and measure: evidence reduction (manual hours), agent overlap, and time-to-evidence for controls. If we achieve >25% reduction in manual evidence, we expand.

Attached: compliance_costs_q3.xlsx (breakdown), vendor_pricing_comparison.csv (updated with PS hours).

Next steps I can take: intro call with Diana and a Vanta rep (to understand retention/archival limits) — I can schedule for Thursday.

Marcus
Sr. Finance Analyst, Redwood Inference

Attachments: compliance_costs_q3.xlsx
From: Diana Park <diana@trustadvisors.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanta Sales <sales@vanta.com>, Drata Ops <ops@drata.io>
Date: 2026-09-05T08:45:20-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence tool consolidation & TrustAdvisors pilot — SOW draft and timing

Hi Hannah / Marcus —

Thanks for the overview and for considering TrustAdvisors. Attached is a draft SOW for a 3-month pilot focused on Payments infra evidence consolidation. High level:
- Week 0–2: discovery + agent inventory (we map what Vanta and Drata are collecting)
- Week 3–6: orchestration + automations (we reduce redundant evidence collection and centralize evidence storage)
- Week 7–12: validation, controls-runbook, and handover to your compliance team

Price for pilot: $24,000 (fixed fee), travel not expected for this scope. We require access to the existing evidence buckets and a read-only admin during discovery. Standard consultant T&Cs are in the SOW; we can accommodate most data-processing language but need standard subprocessor clauses.

If youre comfortable, well send via DocuSign and can start onboarding within 5 business days of signed SOW. Ive ccd Vanta and Drata so they can confirm agent capabilities and retention windows for archival evidence.

Best,
Diana Park
Engagement Lead, TrustAdvisors

Attachments: SOW-TrustAdvisors-Redwood-draft.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:30:55-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence tool consolidation & TrustAdvisors pilot — Legal / Procurement checklist

Thanks, all. Quick legal notes after initial review of the SOW: 

- Data access: SOW must explicitly state read-only access to evidence buckets and no agent write capability.
- Subprocessing: include standard subprocessor list + 30-day notice for changes.
- Indemnity/liability cap: we should keep this within our standard $X cap (I'll attach the redline markup).
- SLA: pilot doesn't require uptime SLAs, but any production rollout will require an SLA section.

Neha — for procurement, preferred path is a PO against our existing consulting vendor code (fastest onboard). If we need a vendor onboarding, that adds ~10 business days. Given Diana's timeline, PO path is the fast route. Please confirm cost center and whether we can use the one-off consulting budget for Q3.

Ive attached a short procurement_summary.pdf with the redlines and the suggested PO language. Also linking the DocuSign draft when Diana sends it will help us expedite.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement_summary.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

DocuSign link (vendor side): https://app.docusign.com/s/ABC123-TrustAdvisors-SOW

Expected timeline: vendor signature within 48 hours, onboard kickoff call (intro + discovery) scheduled for 2026-09-16 if signed. Marcus — please confirm you still want Payments infra as pilot scope; Hannah — once signed, would like to confirm metrics dashboard for manual-evidence-hours by next Tuesday.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
